name: Narrow Deny of a broad wildcard grant does NOT downgrade the wildcard edge
note: Allow s3:* on * with a same-policy Deny of only s3:DeleteBucket. The wildcard-action grant (s3:*) is still confirmed by this policy text - a single denied action does not cover the wildcard - so the allows(actiongroup:s3:*) edge stays confirmed-by-policy, and the Deny is surfaced on its own separate denies edge. Guards against a false downgrade in the other direction.
